_comment: The Genie space (#34), applied by scripts/bi/genie_space.py. Each question carries the SQL that answers it independently, so `check` can compare Genie's answer with a known one.
title: uber-nyc-lakehouse trip economics
description: The app's own trips: Uber's NYC trips the app replayed (TLC public data, the 5% sample, the week of 13-19 January 2025): trips, bookings, driver pay, take rate, fees.
instructions: Trips, gmv, base_fare, driver_pay, platform_take, take_rate, tip_rate, cbd_fees, cbd_trips and avg_duration_min are measures of the metric view mv_trip_economics: use MEASURE(), never AVG of a ratio.
take_rate is 1 - driver pay / base fare, the app's share of the fare. gmv is what riders paid in total, fees and tips included.
Every trip is the app's: there is no provider or company dimension. Dates are pickup dates in New York time; the data covers the days the app replayed.
cbd_fees is the congestion relief zone fee ($1.50 a trip that enters it, from 2025-01-05). The CBD is Manhattan south of and including 60th Street.
agg_recon_daily has one row per day and reconciliation (completeness, fees, payouts): checked and breaks. Zero breaks means the day reconciled.

questions.question: How many trips did the app complete in the week of 13 January 2025?
questions.answer_sql: SELECT MEASURE(trips) FROM ridepulse_dev.gold.mv_trip_economics WHERE pickup_date BETWEEN '2025-01-13' AND '2025-01-19'

questions.question: What was the take rate that week?
questions.answer_sql: SELECT MEASURE(take_rate) FROM ridepulse_dev.gold.mv_trip_economics WHERE pickup_date BETWEEN '2025-01-13' AND '2025-01-19'

questions.question: Which pickup borough had the most trips that week?
questions.answer_sql: SELECT borough FROM ridepulse_dev.gold.mv_trip_economics WHERE pickup_date BETWEEN '2025-01-13' AND '2025-01-19' GROUP BY borough ORDER BY MEASURE(trips) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How much in CBD fees did the app collect that week?
questions.answer_sql: SELECT MEASURE(cbd_fees) FROM ridepulse_dev.gold.mv_trip_economics WHERE pickup_date BETWEEN '2025-01-13' AND '2025-01-19'

questions.question: How many reconciliation breaks were there that week?
questions.answer_sql: SELECT sum(breaks) FROM ridepulse_dev.gold.agg_recon_daily WHERE day BETWEEN '2025-01-13' AND '2025-01-19'
